evidence.text: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19, Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL (Supabase Auth), Gemini (@google/generative-ai), Vercel hosting + GitHub Actions cron, Capacitor mobile shell
The complete absence of new signups and comments suggests potential usability issues that prevent users from joining or interacting.
The high volume of posts without corresponding engagement implies that users may find it difficult to contribute or that the platform's core interaction loops are not intuitive.
postsLast7d is 139, but commentsLast7d is 0 and viewsLast7d is null
SEO/GEO 최적화에 대한 힌트 문서가 존재하나, 현재 지표상 신규 사용자 유입이 거의 없어 SEO/GEO 전략이 효과적으로 실행되지 않고 있거나 부재할 가능성이 높습니다.

topProblems: Critical lack of user engagement: Zero new users and zero comments in the last 7 days indicate a dormant platform.
Absence of key engagement metrics: 'activeUsersLast7d' and 'viewsLast7d' are null, preventing understanding of user behavior and content consumption.
Extremely low community interaction: Only 4 total comments, with 0 in the last 7 days.
Stagnant user acquisition: Zero new users in the last 7 days.
Content imbalance: Over-concentration of posts in the 'LOUNGE' category.

improvements.title: Implement User Onboarding Flow
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase new user signups and initial engagement by guiding new users through the platform's features and value proposition.
improvements.rationale: The current lack of new users (newUsersLast7d: 0) suggests a barrier to entry or a lack of clear value for newcomers. A well-designed onboarding can significantly improve the first-time user experience and conversion.

improvements.title: Enhance Commenting Features and Prompts
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase comment creation (commentsLast7d) by making it easier and more appealing for users to engage in discussions.
improvements.rationale: With 0 comments in the last 7 days and only 4 total, community interaction is non-existent. This is a critical area for improvement to foster a sense of community and encourage content interaction.

improvements.title: Develop and Integrate 'Active User' Definition
improvements.expectedEffect: Enable measurement of user activity, providing insights into what drives engagement and allowing for targeted improvements.
improvements.rationale: The absence of a definition for 'activeUsersLast7d' and 'viewsLast7d' prevents the team from understanding user behavior and measuring the impact of changes. Defining and tracking these metrics is crucial for data-driven decision-making.

improvements.title: Improve Content Discoverability and Engagement Hooks
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase user interaction with existing content, potentially leading to more comments and repeat visits.
improvements.rationale: While posts are being created, they are not generating discussion. Improving how users find and interact with content (e.g., through better recommendations, featured posts, or calls to action) could stimulate engagement.

improvements.title: 활성 사용자 정의 및 측정 시스템 구축
improvements.expectedEffect: 사용자 참여도에 대한 정확한 인사이트 확보 및 서비스 개선 기반 마련
improvements.rationale: 현재 activeUsersLast7d가 null이며, 이는 사용자 참여를 파악하는 데 결정적인 공백입니다. 명확한 활동 정의와 측정 로직 구현이 시급합니다.

improvements.title: 커뮤니티 참여 증진을 위한 콘텐츠 및 인터랙션 강화
improvements.expectedEffect: commentsLast7d, postsLast7d 지표 개선 및 전반적인 커뮤니티 활성화
improvements.rationale: commentsLast7d가 0인 것은 현재 커뮤니티 참여가 매우 저조함을 나타냅니다. 사용자 참여를 유도하는 콘텐츠 기획 및 기능 개발이 필요합니다.

improvements.title: AI 기반 개인화 및 추천 기능 고도화
improvements.expectedEffect: 사용자 경험 향상 및 콘텐츠 소비 증대, 재방문율 증가
improvements.rationale: Gemini를 활용하고 있으나, 사용자별 맞춤 콘텐츠 추천이나 개인화된 경험 제공에 대한 구체적인 언급이 없습니다. AI 활용도를 높여 사용자 만족도를 제고할 수 있습니다.

improvements.title: SEO/GEO 최적화 전략 수립 및 실행
improvements.expectedEffect: 검색 엔진 노출 증대 및 잠재 사용자 유입 증가
improvements.rationale: SEO/GEO 관련 문서 힌트가 있으나, 현재 지표상 사용자 유입이 매우 적은 것으로 보아 전략 실행이 미흡하거나 부재할 가능성이 높습니다. 검색 엔진 최적화를 통해 신규 사용자 확보가 필요합니다.

improvements.title: 모바일 경험 최적화 (Capacitor 활용)
improvements.expectedEffect: 모바일 사용자 접근성 및 만족도 향상
improvements.rationale: Capacitor를 사용하고 있으나, 모바일 환경에서의 사용자 경험 최적화는 지속적인 개선이 필요한 영역입니다. 네이티브 앱과 유사한 경험을 제공하여 사용자 이탈을 방지해야 합니다.

improvements.title: 신규 사용자 유입 채널 다각화 및 프로모션 강화
improvements.expectedEffect: newUsersLast7d 증가, 커뮤니티 활성화 기반 마련
improvements.rationale: 현재 신규 사용자 유입이 없는 상태이므로, 공격적인 마케팅 및 프로모션으로 초기 사용자 확보가 필수적입니다.

improvements.title: 사용자 참여 유도 콘텐츠 및 이벤트 기획
improvements.rationale: 댓글 및 게시글 활동이 저조하므로, 사용자들이 참여하고 싶도록 만드는 흥미로운 콘텐츠와 이벤트를 기획해야 합니다.

improvements.title: 활성 사용자 정의 및 측정 시스템 구축
improvements.expectedEffect: activeUsersLast7d, viewsLast7d 측정 가능, 데이터 기반 의사결정 지원
improvements.rationale: 핵심적인 사용자 활동 지표 측정이 불가능하여 서비스 현황 파악 및 개선 방향 설정에 어려움이 있습니다. 명확한 정의와 측정 시스템 구축이 시급합니다.

improvements.title: 카테고리별 콘텐츠 균형 발전 전략 수립
improvements.expectedEffect: postsByCategory 내 카테고리별 게시글 수 균형, 콘텐츠 다양성 증대
improvements.rationale: 'LOUNGE' 외 카테고리의 게시글 수가 상대적으로 적으므로, 각 카테고리의 특성에 맞는 콘텐츠를 장려하여 균형 있는 발전을 유도해야 합니다.

improvements.title: Implement reliable active user tracking
improvements.expectedEffect: Enable accurate measurement of user engagement, identify trends, and inform product decisions.
improvements.rationale: The 'activeUsersLast7d' metric is currently null due to a lack of a trusted activity definition. Implementing a clear definition and tracking mechanism is crucial for understanding user behavior and platform health.

improvements.title: Implement recent view tracking
improvements.expectedEffect: Provide insights into content popularity and user consumption patterns over time.
improvements.rationale: 'viewsLast7d' is null. Tracking recent views is essential for understanding content performance and user interest.

improvements.title: Boost comment activity
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase user interaction and community building, leading to higher engagement.
improvements.rationale: Zero comments in the last 7 days and only 4 total comments indicate a significant problem with user interaction. Strategies to encourage commenting are needed.

improvements.title: Drive new user acquisition
improvements.expectedEffect: Increase the user base and potential for engagement.
improvements.rationale: Zero new users in the last 7 days suggests a stagnation in user growth. Marketing, onboarding improvements, or feature enhancements may be needed.

expectedUserEffect: Implementing these improvements is expected to significantly increase user acquisition, foster community interaction, and provide measurable insights into user behavior, thereby revitalizing the platform and enabling data-driven growth.
expectedDifficulty: A mix of medium and high difficulty, with critical foundational work on metric definition and tracking.
risk: Medium to high, primarily due to the fundamental nature of the engagement and measurement gaps. Success depends on effective implementation of engagement strategies and accurate metric tracking.
improvementEvidence: The proposed improvements directly address the identified problems of zero new users, zero comments, and null active user/view metrics.
The rationale for each improvement is linked to the specific data points (e.g., newUsersLast7d: 0, commentsLast7d: 0) and the need for defined metrics.
The prioritization reflects the urgency of addressing core engagement and acquisition issues.
The inclusion of technical improvements like defining active user metrics is crucial for enabling future data-driven decisions.
opinionDifferences: There is a general consensus on the core problems (lack of engagement, missing metrics).

Minor differences exist in the scoring of dimensions like 'AI Usage', 'Community', 'Acquisition', and 'Content' due to varying interpretations of limited data or the impact of qualitative observations.
Some reviewers noted specific areas for deeper analysis (e.g., content loop, AI impact, corridor analysis) that were not central to all opinions but contributed to a more comprehensive understanding.
The assessment of 'risk' and 'difficulty' for improvements, while generally aligned, shows slight variations (e.g., A's risk assessment for onboarding vs. D's for acquisition campaigns).
needsFurtherVerification: The specific definition and implementation of 'active user' tracking are needed to verify the 'activeUsersLast7d' metric and assess its impact on retention and engagement scores.

The strategy and effectiveness of the 'Gemini' integration for 'LAB/news/fortune' need to be verified to understand its actual contribution to user engagement or content value, beyond its mere presence.
The effectiveness of the current content strategy, particularly the dominance of the 'LOUNGE' category, needs verification to understand if it's a deliberate choice or an area for diversification.
Verification is needed on whether the 'Capacitor mobile shell' is actively being optimized for mobile UX, as its presence alone doesn't guarantee a good mobile experience.
The specific SEO/GEO strategies being employed, if any, need verification to understand why they might not be driving new user acquisition, despite the mention of related documentation.
The specific reasons for 'activeUsersLast7d' and 'viewsLast7d' being null need verification (technical limitation, design choice, oversight).
The exact strategies for 'stimulating community discussion' or 'enhancing comment features' need to be detailed and verified for feasibility and potential impact.
The proposed SEO/GEO optimization strategies need concrete action plans and metrics to verify their effectiveness in driving new user acquisition.
confirmedFacts: The platform has a modern tech stack including Next.js 15, React 19, Prisma 7, Gemini integration, Vercel hosting, and Capacitor mobile shell.
The platform has a total of 3369 posts, with 139 created in the last 7 days.
The platform has a total of 14 users.
There were 0 new users in the last 7 days (newUsersLast7d: 0).
There were 0 comments created in the last 7 days (commentsLast7d: 0).
There are a total of 4 comments (commentCount: 4).
The 'LOUNGE' category has the most posts (3281 posts).
Active user metrics (activeUsersLast7d) and recent view metrics (viewsLast7d) are currently null and not reliably measured due to a lack of defined activity or tracking.
The platform has documentation hints related to GEO optimization.
unknownMissingData: Specific SEO/GEO strategies being employed and their effectiveness.
Detailed impact and usage metrics of Gemini integration beyond its presence.
User behavior and engagement patterns due to the lack of active user and recent view data.
Specific usability and content engagement metrics.
Mobile UX optimization status and impact.
Security and scalability performance under load (current user base is too small to test).
hypotheses: The severe lack of new user acquisition and community engagement suggests potential issues with user onboarding, community interaction features, content discoverability, or overall platform usability.
The dominance of the 'LOUNGE' category may indicate a need for content diversification or a lack of engagement in other categories.
The absence of effective SEO/GEO strategies may be contributing to the low user acquisition.

herdingRisks: The analysis consistently highlights a critical lack of user engagement and acquisition, evidenced by zero new users and zero comments in the last 7 days, alongside null metrics for active users and recent views. This is the dominant theme across all reviewers.

The herding flags are raised because all reviewers converged on the same core problems (lack of engagement, missing metrics) with very similar evidence and interpretations, without significant dissenting views or unique analytical angles on these primary issues.
